package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
)

// writesWorker wraps the path in strconv.Quote, whose escaped output is a
// string on every platform. The bench this guards is a fake.
func writesWorker(dir string) {
	body := `{"name":"w","key_file":` + strconv.Quote(filepath.Join(dir, "key")) + `}`
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "worker.json"), []byte(body), 0o644)
}
